ask: muse mkae a splitter thing so we dont all bring the same stuff plz
sentence: A shared checklist of items to bring on a trip where each person taps an open item to claim it, taps their own to release it, and anyone can add new items.
use_when: A group is packing for a trip and wants to avoid bringing duplicate gear
Friends need to divide who brings shared items like coolers, tents, or speakers
Everyone should see which items are still unclaimed
A potluck or party needs people to sign up for things to bring
dont_use_when: Splitting money or expenses between people
Scheduling dates or times or voting on a choice
Tracking personal to-do tasks or a private packing list
